title: Income Tax: company car tax rates for 2030 to 2032
text: This measure confirms the appropriate percentage for zero emission and electric vehicles will increase by 1 or 2 percentage points per year in 2030 to 2031 and 2031 to 2032, rising to an appropriate percentage of 12% or 15% in 2031 to 2032.

attachments.title: Taxation of company cars: the appropriate percentage for tax years 2030 to 2031 and 2031 to 2032
